description: Read a timeline document — tracks, clips, timings, and whether it can render (exportable + any blockers) — plus `timelines`, the ids of every timeline in the workspace (main and each short). Pass atSec to also get the rendered frame at that time as an image. Call this to ground yourself BEFORE editing and to VERIFY a change AFTER.

atSec.description: Also return the frame export would render at this timeline time, as an image.

timeline.description: Timeline to work on (default "main"). A short made with make_short is a timeline of its own.

name: timeline_show
title: Show the timeline
